api_setup_steps: 5. Log into DropCatch.com with NameBright credentials at least once
dropcatch.refund_policy: Full refund if domain not caught. Only charged on successful catch.

auction_rules.multiple_backorders: 3-day public auction (anyone can bid, not just backorder holders)
auction_rules.snipe_protection: Bids in last 5 minutes extend auction by 5 minutes

dropcatch.accreditation_note: 1,201+ ICANN registrar accreditations — sends 1,201 simultaneous registration attempts
dropcatch.discount_club_warning: Standard $59 backorders ALWAYS trump Discount Club. Corporate partners also have priority over Discount Club.
dropcatch.best_for: Tier A — any domain with expected competition. Highest catch rate in the industry.

dynadot.best_for: Tier S — uncontested/zero-competition domains where $10.99 is acceptable risk
dynadot.limitations: Only 15 ICANN accreditations — loses nearly every contested drop

snapnames.api_note: No public API found. Manual/browser only.
snapnames.refund_policy: Only charged if domain is caught AND you win the auction

auction_rules.format: Private auction — only backorder holders can bid (NOT public like DropCatch)
auction_rules.bid_limit_default: $2,500 across all active auctions (can be increased)

snapnames.best_for: Tier A supplement — private auction format means lower final prices than DropCatch public auctions

critical_warning.shared_inventory: SnapNames and NameJet share IDENTICAL inventory since 2020 merger
critical_warning.bidding_against_yourself: If you backorder on BOTH SnapNames and NameJet, you bid against yourself
critical_warning.rule: NEVER use both SnapNames AND NameJet — pick ONE platform only

snapnames.second_chance: Bid or Buy program for unsold domains (launched Oct 2025)

namejet.critical_warning: SHARED INVENTORY WITH SNAPNAMES — do NOT use both. Pick one.
namejet.best_for: SKIP — use SnapNames instead (same inventory, same company)

godaddy_auctions.auth_method: API Key + Secret in header (sso-key format)
godaddy_auctions.api_access_note: Email auctions@godaddy.com to request API access

api_endpoints.note: Bid endpoint exists but documentation is sparse. Search and list endpoints limited.

godaddy_auctions.cost_model: Auction format — bids start at variable amounts

auction_rules.snipe_protection: Soft close — bids in final minutes extend auction

godaddy_auctions.best_for: Tier B — GoDaddy-registered expiring domains that bypass registry deletion
godaddy_auctions.limitation: Only covers domains registered at GoDaddy. Does NOT catch registry pending-delete drops.

S.rationale: Dynadot's 15 accreditations sufficient when no competitors exist

A.rationale: DropCatch's 1,201 accreditations for the catch. Dynadot as cheap backup. If DropCatch catches it, auction may push price up.
A.optional_supplement: SnapNames ($79) for private-auction-only opportunity — add if domain value justifies $149 total exposure

A_plus.rationale: Triple-platform coverage maximizes catch probability. SnapNames private auction may yield lower price than DropCatch public auction.

B.description: GoDaddy-registered domains appearing in GoDaddy Auctions
B.rationale: GoDaddy domains never enter registry pending-delete — must bid in GoDaddy Auctions

C.description: Low value — not worth backorder costs
C.rationale: Domain value does not justify even the cheapest backorder ($10.99)

current_queue_estimate.note: DropCatch refunds if not caught. Dynadot refunds if not caught. Actual cost = $0 if nothing drops.

critical_rules.rule_1_no_snapnames_plus_namejet: NEVER backorder the same domain on both SnapNames AND NameJet — shared inventory means you bid against yourself
critical_rules.rule_2_dropcatch_standard_over_discount: Always use standard $59 backorder on DropCatch for priority domains. Discount Club has lower priority.
critical_rules.rule_3_check_registrar_first: Check WHOIS registrar before choosing platform. GoDaddy-registered domains go to GoDaddy Auctions, not pending-delete.
critical_rules.rule_4_set_max_bids: Always set a max bid BEFORE an auction starts. Auctions can escalate quickly.
critical_rules.rule_5_refund_safety: All platforms refund if the domain is not caught. The exposure is $0 until a catch happens.
